title: Not even for my couch
text: Not even for my couch. Holy cats are these useless pillows. Yea, I knew they were down but I figured they'd be soft enough to use on my bed. Nope. The cotton is very heavy which makes arranging the pillow to where you want it darn near impossible. I thought ok, I'd use them for couch pillows. IMPOSSIBLE! You go to sit down and lean on them and the feathers poke thru making it very difficult to get comfy. I'd send them back but a) I won't go in to any store to return right now due to Covid & b) it'd cost too much to make it worth while to have UPS pick them up. Guess I'm just stuck with them.
